decisive_items: concentric proliferation of ovoid tumor cells present around small vessels
CD31 immunostain highlighted many endothelial-lined vascular channels
response.rationale: Vascular-patterned dermal tumor with CD31-positive channels, perivascular ovoid cells, mitoses and necrosis supports angiosarcoma; SCC lacks squamous histology and Kaposi sarcoma is excluded by negative KSHV staining.

rejected.why: Only the prior SCC history supports this; the H&E shows ovoid perivascular proliferation rather than squamous differentiation.
Negative staining for Kaposi sarcoma-associated herpesvirus excludes Kaposi sarcoma.
